F1_extraction.method: exact RGB (4,36,51) painted core, 8-connected components; per-column center of one or two vertical core runs; no ellipse fit, smoothing, image-edge snapping, occlusion bridge or off-video extension

F1_extraction.correlation_note: Successive columns of each ring come from the same continuous user-painted stroke; they are not independent observations.
